context.text: Trump announces that he is willing to engage with Iran to negotiate a deal.
Trump says that he extended the Iran truce to allow time for an Iranian proposal to be submitted at Pakistan's request.
Axios reports that U.S. and Iran negotiators have reached a ceasefire extension deal, pending Trump's approval.
President Trump announces that Operation Project Freedom has been paused, citing progress in negotiations.
The U.S. signs a deal with Saudi Arabia to develop a civilian nuclear program in the country. Trump demands that Saudi Arabia join the Abraham Accords so that the agreement will take effect.

search_miss.question: Who entered negotiations with the Trump administration on March 13, 2026?
search_miss.evidence: March 13 - First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba Miguel Díaz-Canel entered negotiations with the Trump administration in an effort to end the United States embargo against Cuba.

context.text: 4 May – A car plows into a crowd in Grimmaische Strasse in Leipzig, killing two people and injuring 22 others.
A small plane carrying two people crashes into a house in Ganderkesee.
19 June – Two freight trains collide in Munich, killing one person.
27 August – Two people are killed in an incident of domestic violence at a school in Gosen-Neu Zittau.
